name: get_order_status
description: Look up a Shopify order after verifying the caller with the order number plus the email or phone used at checkout. Call this when the caller asks where their order is, whether it shipped, or whether tracking is available.

properties.name: order_number
properties.description: The Shopify order number the caller gives, e.g. #1234. Ask for this before calling.

properties.name: customer_email
properties.description: The email address used at checkout. Required unless the caller provides the checkout phone number.

properties.name: customer_phone
properties.description: The phone number used at checkout. Required unless the caller provides the checkout email address.

properties.name: conversation_id
properties.description: Optional ElevenLabs conversation identifier if available.
